4.constraint: Use this clean French-blue relaxed short-sleeve overshirt once only for Spring/Summer Casual Everyday, Weekend, Travel, Campus, daytime Date or creative casual Party. These hanger or product-only tops provide no convincing adult-male fit, movement or hem-length proof and are too generic or dark to justify approval.
